title: 第19章 惊怖和道心第20章 参悟
content_zh:
“645……644……639……”
一名又一名同学的身影浮现在钱深的面前，他看不清他们的身影，却能清楚看到他们脑袋上显示的分数。
“680，690，660……”
每一个人头上显示的分数都是如此高不可攀，如此闪闪发光，让此刻的钱深自惭形秽。
他感觉自己站在同学们的面前，是如此不堪，如此卑微如喽啰。
“我站在这些人中，简直就像是一袋湿垃圾。”
“区区600多分的我，根本不配站在这里，更不配和他们说话，不配靠近他们……”
在他眼中，那一名名同学脑袋上的分数不断提升，身影也随着不断拔高，如同一个个高耸入云的巨人一般，他甚至渐渐只能看到对方的双腿，连对方的面庞都看不清了。
……
与此同时，画展的另一边，邙山高中李星宇的无人机在半空中划过一道轨迹，便朝着天人演武图的方向缓缓飞去。
但下一刻，便随着噼啪一声炸响，无人机便像是发生了某种故障，歪歪斜斜地落在了地上。
“邙山高中的魂修生一身的合同，就别来凑热闹了。”
李雪莲轻轻念叨一下，接着目光便从无人机上收了回来，继续看向了其他学生。
“可惜，这次画展来尝试的学生们几乎都是高一的，想要练成天人演武图上的武功，高二高三的学生才更有机会。”
“但也难怪……高二、高三的学霸们要么年龄不符合要求，要么早就有合同在身，也不可能再来找个师父了。”
就在这时，浑身金光闪闪的仙韵集团嵩阳市总监来到了李雪莲的身旁，微笑着说道“这天人演武图不愧是星火真人亲绘，真是神妙异常，不知其中要考校的到底是什么？”
李雪莲没有直接回答对方的问题，而是淡淡说道“天人演武图的第一关，考的是道心。”
“经受不住的，往往都会被强行逼退，甚至在道心中留下一番破绽。”
……
赵天行感受着周围无数人轻蔑、嘲笑的目光，身体忍不住向后连连退去，远离了天人演武图的作用范围。

当他回过神来时，看着四周围的状况，这才明白刚刚‘全场围观’、‘蔑视眼神’都不过是天人演武图的作用。
想到这里，明白自己根本没通过天人演武图的考验，他的脸色立刻胀得通红，快步向后退去，生怕周围有人发现他这个保安自取其辱。
……
画展上，李雪莲接着说道“若能通过这第一关的考验，自有磨砺一番道心的效果。”
“所谓道心等级，我们绝大多数修士都是靠着心法去提升。”
“而不同的心法，需要不同的思想去契合。”
“像是古代的拜神心法，修炼者就必须无比虔诚，对神灵有着绝对的信仰之心，越是虔诚，拜神心法的效果便越好。”
“又像是紫云高中的天勤心法，便需要修炼者苦修到极致，将苦修融入自己的本能，才能发挥最大功效。”
“又比如高中生入门的基础炼心法，求的是一个静气凝神，需要的是默默忍耐、水滴石穿的思想来配合。”
“提升道心的心法千千万万，有高有低，但关键看修炼者有没有契合心法的思想。”
“可思想难测，一个人究竟是怎么想的，是不是真的与心法相契合，别说外人了，有时候就连他自己也未必说的清。”
“索性道心越强，人的意志力便也越强，通过意志力的强弱来测定道心等级，检验心法提升的效果，就成了最简单的办法。”
“但天人演武图，并不只是简简单单通过测试意志力的强弱，来确认道心的强弱。”
“天人演武图，针对的是心中惊怖，是直接敲打人心灵上的弱点，不给他们用心法去抵抗的机会，测试的就是他们最本真的反应。”
“在面对心灵上的弱点时，只有及时调整思想，才能弥补心中弱点，方可过关。”
仙韵集团嵩阳市总监目光一动，说道“我明白了，星火前辈是想要一个思想灵活的弟子？一个练习拜神心法，能换着神拜，练习天勤心法，既能在苦修上卷，也能在躺平上卷的徒弟。”
李雪莲点了点头“心法万千，思想能契合心法固然好。但只有能不断调整自己的思想，适应环境变化，适应心法变化的人，才是真正的天才，不被心法所束缚。”
“特别是如今时代发展越来越快，十大宗门影响着社会中的方方面面，整个昆墟都在发生激烈变化，思想不能及时去适应，那是不行的。”
“比如当今之世，想要踏上修仙之路，考试、分数都必不可少，早就融入了每一名修仙者的生活中。”
“于是现代修仙者的思想中，自然也少不了对考试、分数的执着。”
content_en:
"645...644...639..."
The figures of one classmate after another appeared in front of Qian Shen. He could not see their figures clearly, but he could clearly see the scores displayed on their heads.
"680, 690, 660..."
The scores displayed on everyone's head are so unattainable and so sparkling that money at this moment is ashamed of itself.
He felt that he was standing in front of his classmates, so unbearable, so humble as a slave.
“I was standing in the middle of these people like a bag of wet garbage.”
"With a mere score of over 600, I am not worthy of standing here, let alone talking to them, and I am not worthy of being close to them..."
In his eyes, the scores on the heads of each classmate continued to increase, and their figures continued to rise, like giants towering into the sky. He could only gradually see each other's legs, and could not even see their faces clearly.
…
At the same time, on the other side of the art exhibition, Li Xingyu's drone from Mangshan High School traced a trajectory in mid-air, and then slowly flew towards the direction of the picture of heaven and man performing martial arts.
But the next moment, there was a crackling sound, and the drone seemed to have some kind of malfunction and fell to the ground crookedly.
"The soul cultivator of Mangshan High School has a contract, so don't join in the fun."
Li Xuelian muttered softly, then looked away from the drone and continued to look at the other students.
"Unfortunately, almost all the students who come to this art exhibition to try are first-year students in high school. If they want to practice the martial arts shown in the martial arts diagram of Heaven and Man, only students in the second and third years of high school have a better chance."
"But it's no wonder... the top students in the second and third year of high school either don't meet the age requirements, or they already have contracts, and it's impossible to find another master."
At this moment, the director of Songyang City of Xianyun Group, who was covered in golden light, came to Li Xuelian's side and said with a smile, "This picture of Tianren martial arts is worthy of being drawn by Master Xinghuo. It is really magical. I wonder what is going to be tested in it?"
Li Xuelian did not answer the other party's question directly, but said lightly, "The first level of the Heavenly Man's Martial Art is to test the Taoist heart."
"Those who can't stand it are often forced to retreat, and even leave some flaws in the Taoist heart."
…
Zhao Tianxing felt the contempt and ridicule of countless people around him, and his body couldn't help but retreated backwards, away from the scope of the Tianren Martial Arts Diagram.
When he came back to his senses and looked at the situation around him, he realized that the "whole crowd watching" and "contemptuous looks" just now were just the effects of heaven and man performing martial arts.
Thinking of this, he realized that he had not passed the test of Tianren Wutu at all. His face immediately turned red and he quickly stepped back, fearing that someone around him would find that he, the security guard, had humiliated himself.
…
At the art exhibition, Li Xuelian continued, "If you can pass this first test, it will have the effect of sharpening your Taoist heart."
"The so-called Taoist level, most of our monks rely on mental methods to improve it."
"And different mental methods require different thoughts to fit in."
"For example, in the ancient method of worshiping gods, practitioners must be extremely pious and have absolute faith in gods. The more pious they are, the better the effect of the method of worshiping gods."
"Again, like Ziyun High School's Tianqin Mental Technique, it requires practitioners to practice hard to the extreme and integrate hard work into their own instincts in order to achieve maximum effectiveness."
"Another example is the basic mind-training method for high school students. What is required is a calm and concentrated mind. What is needed is to be patient and patient in silence, and to cooperate with the thoughts of water droplets."
"There are thousands of mental methods for improving the Taoist mind, some are high and some are low, but the key is to see whether the practitioner has thoughts that are consistent with the mental methods."
"But thoughts are unpredictable. What a person is thinking and whether it is really consistent with his mind, let alone outsiders, sometimes even he himself may not be able to tell clearly."
"Simply the stronger the Taoist heart, the stronger the person's willpower will be.It is the simplest way to measure the level of Taoist heart through the strength of willpower and test the effect of improving the mental method. "
“But the Heavenly Man’s Martial Art is not just about testing the strength of willpower to confirm the strength of Taoist heart. "
"The Heavenly Man's Martial Art is aimed at the fear in people's hearts, and directly attacks the weaknesses of people's hearts. It does not give them a chance to resist with their mental skills, and what is tested is their most authentic reaction. "
“When faced with spiritual weaknesses, only by adjusting your thoughts in time can you make up for the weaknesses in your heart and pass the test. "
The Director of Songyang City of Xianyun Group moved his eyes and said, "I understand, does Senior Xinghuo want a disciple with flexible thinking? A disciple who practices the mental method of worshiping gods, can switch to worshiping gods, practices the mental method of Tianqin, and can roll the scroll while doing ascetic practices and lying down. "
Li Xuelian nodded, "There are thousands of thoughts, and it's good if your thoughts can match your thoughts. But only those who can constantly adjust their thoughts, adapt to changes in the environment, and changes in their mental methods are true geniuses and are not bound by their mental methods. "
“Especially now that the times are developing faster and faster, the ten major sects are affecting all aspects of society, and the entire Kunxu is undergoing drastic changes. It will not work if the mind cannot adapt in time. "
"For example, in today's world, if you want to embark on the path of cultivating immortals, exams and scores are essential, and they have long been integrated into the life of every cultivator. "
“So the obsession with exams and scores is naturally indispensable in the minds of modern cultivators. "
